spans.s: त्य॑—जप (त्य॑-), m. that (i.e. a lower kind of) muttering (opposed to महाजप॑), MaitrS. ii, 9, 1, 12.

giving up, offering, BhP. viii; Rājat. iv

त्यक्त—पुनः-स्वि-कृत (in rhet.) resuming what has been suspended, Kpr.

to be left or abandoned, W.

nom. स्य॑ (स्), स्या॑, त्य॑द्, (g. सर्वादि) that (often used like an article, e.g. त्य॑त् पणीनां॑ व॑सु, ‘that i.e. the wealth of the Paṇis’, RV. ix, 111, 2; sometimes strengthened by चि॑द्; often put after उत॑, or after another demonstrative in the beginning of a sentence), RV.; AV. vii, 14, 1; ŚBr. xiv (त्य॑स्य = म॑म, 4, 1, 26; n. त्य॑म् for त्य॑द्, 5, 3, 1 and [in the etymology of सत्य॑म्] KauṣUp.), TUp. ii, 6
indeed, namely, as it is known (always preceded by ह), RV.
त्यत्र—त्य mfn. being there, Vop. vii, 111.
(patr. fr. त्यद्) the son of that person, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 156; Siddh.
id., ib. (त्यद्˚ ed., but cf. ताद्˚, याद्˚).
such a one as that, iii, 2, 60.
